"""Construct a distribution whose forward and backward KL divergences from
the uniform distribution are both 10.0.

With U_i = 1/N, the two quantities are

    KL(P || U) = sum_i P_i log(N * P_i)
    KL(U || P) = (1/N) sum_i -log(N * P_i)

The construction uses:
  * 7 large-probability tokens (six equal, one slightly larger), and
  * N - 7 equal, very small tail probabilities.

The large tokens produce the required forward KL (entropy log(N) - 10),
while the tiny tail makes the average log-probability, and hence the
backward KL, equal to 10 as well.
"""

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

N = 150_000
K_LARGE = 7
TARGET_KL = 10.0


def build_distribution(tail_mass: float, small_large_prob: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """Build the distribution for the two scalar parameters."""
    remaining_large_mass = (1.0 - tail_mass) - 6.0 * small_large_prob
    tail_prob = tail_mass / (N - K_LARGE)

    p = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
    p[:6] = small_large_prob
    p[6] = remaining_large_mass
    p[K_LARGE:] = tail_prob
    return p


def kl_divergences(p: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Return (KL(P || U), KL(U || P)) for uniform U."""
    log_np = np.log(N * p)
    forward = float(np.dot(p, log_np))
    backward = float(-np.mean(log_np))
    return forward, backward


def objective(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    tail_mass, small_large_prob = x
    p = build_distribution(tail_mass, small_large_prob)
    forward, backward = kl_divergences(p)
    return np.array([forward - TARGET_KL, backward - TARGET_KL])


def main() -> None:
    # Initial guess: tail mass ~ exp(-10), with the large mass spread over 7.
    initial = np.array([np.exp(-TARGET_KL), (1.0 / 7.0) * 0.896])
    solution = root(objective, initial, method="hybr", options={"xtol": 1e-14})

    if not solution.success:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Root finding failed: {solution.message}")

    tail_mass, small_large_prob = solution.x
    p = build_distribution(tail_mass, small_large_prob)

    # Basic validity checks.
    if np.any(p <= 0.0):
        raise RuntimeError("Distribution contains non-positive probabilities.")
    if not np.isclose(p.sum(), 1.0, atol=1e-12):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Probabilities sum to {p.sum()}, not 1.")

    forward, backward = kl_divergences(p)
    if abs(forward - TARGET_KL) > 1e-3 or abs(backward - TARGET_KL) > 1e-3:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"KL targets not met: forward={forward}, backward={backward}"
        )

    np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)

    print(f"forward KL(P||U) = {forward:.12f}")
    print(f"backward KL(U||P) = {backward:.12f}")
    print(f"sum = {p.sum():.12f}, min = {p.min():.6e}, max = {p.max():.12f}")
    print("Saved /app/dist.npy")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from scipy.special import rel_entr

print('backward:', bwd)
